title: vaultSecurityAudit
responsibility: Judges a provider security log over a Credential Vault lease window.

inputs.name: vaultSecurityAudit.events
inputs.description: Provider security log entries reduced to kind, time and session, or null when the log could not be read.

inputs.name: vaultSecurityAudit.window
inputs.description: Lease start and end and the provider sessions the scripted login created.

outputs.name: vaultSecurityAudit
outputs.description: Clean with the number of events checked, an alert with the findings, or unverifiable with the reason.
